title: Tools And Equipment Details
request: Oct 19 2026 16:10 ICT: Max asked 'prepare fresh new decks on the same topics i swiped on. they don't have to be as long. i like 10 at a time.'
example_data: Laptop browser mockups (1366 wide) of the board in its decided state with a CLOSE-UP panel for the asked element; TEST / SAMPLE data, Tech Dash 1-3, Van 1-3, members by first name or ID only. Thumbnail grid on laptop, carousel on phone; supplier and cost tucked away; nothing bought without Max's approval; tool list, van setup and suppliers stay Open.
no_cap: Max asked for 10 at a time (Oct 19 2026)

pairs.ask: Tools And Equipment Board: Thumbnail tile, on the laptop thumbnail grid, should each tile be a photo with a name or an icon with name and item count?

optionA.label: Photo With Name
optionA.desc: A small photo of the kit, name under.
